title: Media, Information and Evidence: Evaluating Unverified Online Claims
prompt: In many countries, people increasingly rely on social media and other online platforms for news, and unverified claims can spread quickly before they are checked. Some commentators argue that the main responsibility for limiting the harm of such misinformation should lie with the platforms that distribute it, while others believe that individual readers must take greater responsibility for judging what they see. To what extent do you agree that platforms, rather than individual readers, should bear the main responsibility for limiting the harm caused by unverified online information? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先明确题目要求你讨论的核心问题：平台与个人读者谁应承担限制网络不实信息危害的主要责任。写作时需清楚表明自己的立场，并在全文中保持一致；对双方观点都要进行分析，说明为何你更支持某一方。请使用具体但合理的例子支持论点，避免编造统计数据或引用不存在的官方报告。建议先规划段落结构，确保每个主体段都有清晰的中心句和论证，最后检查字数是否达到至少250词。
